reasons: Miranda's lake record verifies the custodial-interrogation definition, but its disclosed pinpoints do not verify the full warnings-plus-waiver admissibility rule.

Innis, Beheler, Stansbury, Thompson, and Quarles lake records support parts of the callout, but the callout cites only Miranda and Quarles and lacks two affirmative approvals for every black-letter component.
Defaulting to refuted on uncertainty is required because the missing waiver and volunteered-statement support cannot be confirmed from the disclosed files.
residual_risks: The proposition may be legally correct, but this record set does not disclose enough support to verify it at the stated breadth.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Split the rule into separately cited clauses: Miranda for custody/interrogation and warnings, Beheler/Stansbury/Thompson for custody, Innis for interrogation, and Quarles only for the public-safety exception.
